desc:
A mystery-solving disaster prevention adventure where you learn how to move in emergencies while having fun!

In the ordinary town, a sudden incident occurs.
What will you do in that situation?
Solve the mysteries and protect your life and the lives of those around you.

・The stage can be played alone
・You can play until the end without spending money
・Easy Japanese that even elementary school students can read
・There are also "Disaster Prevention Mini-Games" you can play right away
(Children under 8 years old are recommended to play with their families)

We have received feedback from players that the stages are too difficult,
We are sequentially adding "Easy Mode."
The gym and arcade are now open for play! Please wait a little longer for other stages.

[Update Information]
🎉 Disaster Prevention Town Festival is now underway! Try on a work outfit in the fitting room and receive it for free (until November 23rd)
🎪 You can participate in a fashion show on the runway!
🐣 Added "Easy Mode"
